description: Change the settings of one project; a field you leave out keeps its value. status paused or archived stops new missions in the project, and active starts them again. autoMerge sets whether SHIP merges a ready pull request by itself. defaultSandboxTemplateId sets the sandbox the agents start in (null for the platform base). repoFullName and linearTeamKey connect the project to another repository or Linear team through the organization's existing connections. Change only what a person asked for. Answers the project as it now stands. Requires the projects:admin scope and the config:write capability.

autoMerge.description: true merges a ready pull request without a person

defaultSandboxTemplateId.description: A sandbox id (sbt_...) from list_sandbox_templates, or null for the platform base

issueCode.description: A GitHub Issues project's issue id prefix, 2-5 characters; only new ids use it

linearTeamKey.description: The key of the Linear team to connect, e.g. ENG

repoFullName.description: owner/repo of the repository to connect, through the organization's GitHub connection

name: update_project
title: Change a project's settings
